## 2.4 INSPECT OIL DEFLECTORS T1 AND T2
THRUST BEARING
Part Condition: Good
Part Condition Description
The thrust bearing was disassembled, inspected, and cleaned.  The inactive thrust pads
were in good condition with no signs of overheating or unbonded babbitt.  The active side
was in good condition as well.  The Thrust bearings were sent to the service shop for a stack
check via customer request.
The opening bump check (rotor float) was .017".
CBM: NA

## 2.5 THRUST BEARING ASSEMBLY
UNIT 3 T1 T2 THRUST FINAL REPORTS.PDF




GAS TURBINE - CLEARANCES
BEARING CLEARANCES
Part Condition: Good
Part Condition Description
As part of the work scope FieldCore was tasked with gathering lift oil checks prior to
unit disassembly. As such dial indicators were placed on the T1 and T2 bearing areas,
hydraulics and lift oil turned on and a measurement taken at each bearing. The lift on T1
was .0035" and the lift on T2 bearing was found to be .003". Thrust bearing bump check was
recorded at .017" and in limits.

## 4.7 1A BFP
TECO-Westinghouse 
Figure 17. EMI Signature for 1A BFP 
This was the first (1st) EMI evaluation for this TECO-Westinghouse, 3500 HP, 3579 RPM, 4 kV, 3 PH, 60 Hz, 
420 A motor, SN: DM D14203-1. The EMI data was collected from an RFCT placed around the frame ground. 
A photograph of this location can be found at the end of the report. 
The motor was loaded to 91% of the rated load. 
The EMI signature showed process noise, data, and radio signals in the LF, MF, and HF ranges. Minor PD and 
corona were detected in the MF to HF range. Current levels are low and do not indicate immediate concern.  
A scan for radiated EMI did not show any significant activity. 
Recommend retesting in 1-2 years to trend changes.
